# Villa Venere - Amalfi Coast

Villa Venere is a private holiday villa at Via Lannio 8, Cetara, Italy, on the Amalfi Coast. It has three bedrooms, accommodates up to 12 adults, and offers a panoramic sea-view terrace and private access to the sea.
